words.gloss: they will not be subject to

literal: To be respected they will not be subject to, glory they will lose, always, liquor desire having, those who live.
translation: Those who live with an abiding desire for liquor will never command the respect of others, and they will lose their reputation for all time.
modern: மதுவின் மீது விருப்பம் கொண்டு வாழ்பவர்கள், எப்போதும் பிறரால் மதிக்கப்பட மாட்டார்கள்; தங்களுடைய புகழையும் இழப்பார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet introduces the chapter on avoiding liquor by highlighting the social consequences of addiction. The poet states that those who live with a constant desire for alcohol will lose two essential elements of a dignified life: the respect of others and their own personal glory. The word 'உட்கு' refers to the awe-inspired respect or fear that a person of dignity commands, which an addict loses completely. This loss of esteem and reputation is not temporary but persists at all times, as indicated by 'எஞ்ஞான்றும்'.
